questions.history: Ask about `Optional<Integer>` to LocalDate with default converters.
questions.prediction: The PR reports true followed by conversion failure before. Expect false and a ConverterNotFoundException on a direct attempt after.
questions.basis: An Integer has no default LocalDate conversion. The merged regression checks predicate and exception together.
questions.refutation: The merged predicate offers the conversion, or the direct attempt produces a date.

questions.history: Change target to String with the same Optional.of(42). Also ask about raw Optional to LocalDate.
questions.prediction: Both revisions should say true and yield `42` as a String for the typed conversion. The raw predicate should remain true.
questions.basis: Default number-to-string conversion supplies the value. Raw Optional has no declared element that would rule a converter out.
questions.refutation: A typed value is lost, or an unknown element type is rejected up front.

questions.history: On the landing use a fresh service with an explicit Integer→LocalDate converter defined by LocalDate.ofEpochDay. Repeat the original query and convert Optional.of(42).
questions.prediction: The predicate should now be true and the result 1970-02-12.
questions.basis: The supplied conversion defines the expected result. An implementation that simply rejects all Optional-to-date pairs cannot satisfy it.
questions.refutation: The newly registered path stays unavailable or unwraps to the wrong date.
